f1-immobiliare.public: Proprietari di immobili residenziali in Valle di Susa che stanno valutando la vendita o vogliono conoscere il valore reale dell'immobile
f1-immobiliare.main_message: Prima di vendere casa, il valore va verificato con dati, comparabili, microzona e domanda reale.

inventory.rule: The feed starts from eligible posts from followed accounts, then integrity systems remove content that violates platform rules.
inventory.production_implication: Every asset must be policy-safe, clear, original/reusable as permitted, and designed for an identifiable audience.

signals.rule: Ranking uses multiple input signals about the creator, the media type, prior interactions and the current post.
signals.production_implication: Do not optimize for one vanity metric. Build content around audience relevance, media fit, prior comparable performance and meaningful actions.

predictions.rule: The system predicts which posts a person may find useful and relevant.
predictions.production_implication: Before creation define one audience, one objective and one message that gives that audience a clear reason to stop, consume and act.

ranking_score.rule: Eligible posts are scored for relevance and ordered; the feed also seeks a useful mix of content types.
ranking_score.production_implication: Score each draft against predicted useful actions and avoid repetitive creative patterns.

signals: how often the viewer advances to the next card
number of units in the carousel
creative_rules: Card 1 must create a precise reason to continue.
Each card must add new information and create a logical reason to swipe.
Do not pad the carousel with redundant slides.
The last card must close the information loop or present the single coherent action.

signals: media type used to estimate expected viewing time
creative_rules: Create something meaningful for the selected audience, not generic engagement bait.
Make the subject immediately recognizable.
Use the media format that best serves the message rather than forcing every idea into one format.

signals: whether the post is photo, video or carousel
relative probability of skipping this post versus adjacent posts
creative_rules: Remove weak introductions.
Put the relevant subject, problem, desire, result or information in the first visible unit.
Avoid generic stock-like, confusing, blurred or visually unrelated assets.
Keep visual text short and immediately readable.

signals: profile visit after viewing the post
creative_rules: Make brand identity visible without overwhelming the content.
Create enough credibility or curiosity that the target has a reason to inspect the profile.
Keep the post coherent with the profile positioning so the transition to the profile makes sense.

signals: whether content is informational such as news, product reviews, tutorials or instructions
recency of the post within 90 days
opening the share sheet and selecting a recipient
creative_rules: Where appropriate, prefer useful information people may naturally send to another person.
Do not ask for meaningless shares; make the information itself share-worthy.
Use current, relevant and specific information when the subject is time-sensitive.

signals: for photos, amount of overlaid text
creative_rules: For photos, do not overload the image with text.
Use one primary visual message and move explanation to the caption when necessary.
Design the content so understanding requires useful attention, not confusion.

signals: whether the first post was actually viewed
time spent on the first post
whether the post is first in feed
creative_rules: Assume every post may be the first item a follower sees.
The first visible unit must work without prior context.
Do not rely on a slow setup to explain why the content matters.

signals: total viewing time including Reels shown in feed
creative_rules: Create a strong first 1-3 seconds and a reason to continue beyond the hook.
Do not reveal only the hook and then repeat it; add progressive value.
For video, structure the middle so the viewer has a reason to stay beyond 10 seconds.
Design audio intentionally with music, voiceover or sound effects when rights permit.
The content must remain understandable with captions/context even if audio is not activated.
Audio should support the message rather than exist as decoration.

signals: whether the post is first in feed
whether it was viewed for at least 3 seconds
time spent in the rest of the session after the first post
creative_rules: Optimize the first impression for immediate relevance and low confusion.
Avoid clickbait that disappoints after the first seconds.
Deliver value quickly enough that the post contributes positively to the viewing session.

gallery_suggestion_metadata.production_implication: When owned gallery metadata is available, it may be used to organize candidate media, but presence of people/animals is not itself a quality signal and must still be checked against the content brief.

reels_creative_essentials.audio: Use intentional audio when rights permit; Meta guidance identifies audio as a key Reels creative element.
reels_creative_essentials.safe_area: Keep the bottom 35% free of essential creative elements, text and logos so interface overlays do not obscure the message.
reels_creative_essentials.message: Keep primary messages inside the safe area.
reels_creative_essentials.first_frame: The first frame/first seconds must make the subject and value understandable immediately.
reels_creative_essentials.captions: Use captions/subtitles when they improve context, clarity and accessibility.
reels_creative_essentials.brand: Show the brand clearly and coherently, especially for conversion-oriented Reels.
reels_creative_essentials.harmony: Use visually coherent clips/assets; avoid mixing unrelated styles and shooting conditions without a reason.
reels_creative_essentials.production_quality: Professional-only footage is not required; phone footage is acceptable when clear, coherent and useful.

do: show special offers when genuinely relevant
use a clear purchase/action CTA when the objective is conversion
dont: mix footage created at very different times/styles without coherence
assume only professionally shot footage can work

do: show the value of taking the action immediately
build the Reel toward the final action
dont: focus only on lifestyle or atmosphere when the objective is a measurable action

team_expertise: close with a clear next step

reels_editing.animate_static_images: Use movement/transitions when turning static images into Reels, but movement must improve viewing rather than distract.
reels_editing.subtitles: Add subtitles/captions to contextualize, clarify and improve accessibility.
reels_editing.audio: Use rights-cleared/royalty-free audio; Meta Audio Collection is one supported source in the supplied guidance.
reels_editing.cutout: Background removal/cutout may be used to emphasize subjects, text or alternate backgrounds when coherent.

rules: Use AI to scale what already works, renew creative faster and reuse existing assets.
Generated text variants must be based on the brand tone and prior high-performing ads/content when such data exists.
Convert existing video to 9:16 without damaging the subject or brand coherence.
AI output remains subject to the same quality, truthfulness, brand and rights checks as manually produced media.

instagram.rule: Use actual account/page data when present. Never fabricate ranking performance, watch-time, skip, share, save, profile-visit or audio metrics.

publication_timing.rule: Use actual Page/Instagram Insights audience-online data. Never invent a best time.
